name: dragme
author: Antigravity
description: Voice drag requests: ask to be pulled into a voice channel and let the people inside approve with one click. Approvals move you or grant a temporary connect pass.
short: Ask to be dragged into a voice channel.
end_user_data_statement: Temporarily stores voice drag request metadata (requesting user ID, target channel ID, timestamp) in Redis with automatic TTL expiration. Cleared immediately upon request completion, rejection, or expiration.
